blocks.etymology: From Old French verbal, from Late Latin verbālis (“belonging to a word”). Equivalent to verb + -al.

wiktionary.gloss: A verb form which does not function as a predicate, or a word derived from a verb. In English, infinitives, participles and gerunds are verbals.
